# IRoundsVaultBaseErrors
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/rounds-vault/IRoundsVaultBaseErrors.sol)

**Title:**
IRoundsVaultBaseErrors

**Author:**
Roberto Cano <robercano>

Custom errors used by the `RoundsVaultBase` contract.


## Errors
### CanOnlyRedeemCurrentRound
Reverts when a current-round redemption is attempted with a receipt id that does not
match the current open round.

Reserved for future use / not currently thrown.


```solidity
error CanOnlyRedeemCurrentRound(uint256 receiptId, uint256 currentRound);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`receiptId`|`uint256`|The receipt id that was supplied|
|`currentRound`|`uint256`|The id of the currently open round|

### CanOnlyRedeemBatchCurrentRound
Reverts on a batch current-round redemption where one or more receipt ids do not match
the current open round.

Reserved for future use / not currently thrown.


```solidity
error CanOnlyRedeemBatchCurrentRound(uint256[] receiptIds, uint256 currentRound);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`receiptIds`|`uint256[]`|The receipt ids that were supplied|
|`currentRound`|`uint256`|The id of the currently open round|

### CannotRedeeemExchangeAssetCurrentRound
Reverts when `redeemExchangeAsset` is called with the current round id (only past
settled rounds are exchangeable for the exchange asset).

Note: error name retains a historical "Redeeem" misspelling; do not change without
coordinated rename across all call sites and ABIs.


```solidity
error CannotRedeeemExchangeAssetCurrentRound(uint256 receiptId, uint256 currentRound);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`receiptId`|`uint256`|The receipt id that was supplied|
|`currentRound`|`uint256`|The id of the currently open round|

### CannotRedeeemBatchExchangeAssetCurrentRound
Reverts when `redeemExchangeAssetBatch` is called with one or more current-round ids.

Note: error name retains a historical "Redeeem" misspelling; do not change without
coordinated rename across all call sites and ABIs.

Reserved for future use / not currently thrown.


```solidity
error CannotRedeeemBatchExchangeAssetCurrentRound(uint256[] receiptIds, uint256 currentRound);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`receiptIds`|`uint256[]`|The receipt ids that were supplied|
|`currentRound`|`uint256`|The id of the currently open round|

### RoundNotSettled
Reverts when an exchange redemption targets a round that is not in the `Settled` state.


```solidity
error RoundNotSettled(uint256 roundNumber);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`roundNumber`|`uint256`|The round id that was supplied|

### InvalidRoundState
Reverts when a state transition expects the round in a specific `RoundState` but it is
actually in another state (covers `nextRound`, `setRoundSettled`, `retryRound`,
`emergencyRollbackRound`, `redeem`, `redeemBatch`).


```solidity
error InvalidRoundState(
    uint256 roundNumber,
    IRoundsVaultBaseEnums.RoundState currentRoundState,
    IRoundsVaultBaseEnums.RoundState expectedRoundState
);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`roundNumber`|`uint256`|The round id that was operated on|
|`currentRoundState`|`IRoundsVaultBaseEnums.RoundState`|The state the round is actually in|
|`expectedRoundState`|`IRoundsVaultBaseEnums.RoundState`|The state the operation required|

### RoundsVaultPositionTooSmall
Reverts when an entry/exit leaves the user with a non-zero aggregate position below
`minPositionSize`. The aggregate combines open receipts (treated as assets for the
`Input` flavor) with target-vault shares converted to assets via `convertToAssets`.


```solidity
error RoundsVaultPositionTooSmall(address account, uint256 currentBalance, uint256 minRequired);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`account`|`address`|The user whose post-flight balance was checked|
|`currentBalance`|`uint256`|The user's aggregate position size, in target-vault assets|
|`minRequired`|`uint256`|The configured minimum position size|

### CannotRetryCurrentRound
Reverts when `retryRound` is called with the current round id; `retryRound` only
operates on past rounds that the governor has rolled back to `Opened`.


```solidity
error CannotRetryCurrentRound(uint256 roundId, uint256 currentRound);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`roundId`|`uint256`|The round id that was supplied|
|`currentRound`|`uint256`|The id of the currently open round|
